d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at a crucial week for global diplomacy as Asia becomes the centre of attention, with major summits taking place in Manila and Shenzhen. We examine the ASEAN Summit and the Quad Leaders’ Meeting in the Philippines, exploring why the Quad appears to be losing momentum under Donald Trump and how strained India-US relations and Washington’s changing approach towards China are affecting the grouping.
